actions.name: Create volume shadow copy using vssadmin.exe
actions.description: Actors initiate the process by creating a volume shadow copy of the system drive using a command such as vssadmin.exe Create Shadow /for=C:.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Use ntdsutil.exe to create snapshot of Active Directory database
actions.description: Actors use ntdsutil.exe with the command sequence ntdsutil snapshot “activate instance ntds” create quit quit to interact with the shadow copy.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Extract ntds.dit file from volume shadow copy
actions.description: Actors access the shadow copy to extract the ntds.dit file from the \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy[X]\Windows\NTDS directory.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Use PSExec.exe to remotely execute commands with SYSTEM privileges
actions.description: Actors use PSExec.exe with the -s switch to run commands remotely with SYSTEM privileges, e.g., to remove port proxy configurations on a remote host.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

relations.rationale: ntdsutil.exe is employed to interact with the shadow copy created by vssadmin.exe
Extraction of ntds.dit file is done from the shadow copy created and interacted with by ntdsutil.exe
